script_text: Stop! Aries, the cosmos is flashing urgent signals now. Fiery Mars, your ruling planet, squares the Sun in your 1st House, sparking impulsive clashes with self‑identity. This tension urges you to temper reckless assertiveness as Venus trines the Midheaven in the 10th House, easing career friction. Single Aries, the bright Venus trine fuels magnetic charisma, so project confidence and authenticity to attract a passionate partner. If you’re already partnered, this aspect highlights the need for open communication, urging you to express affection without impulsive outbursts. In the 10th House, the Venus‑Midheaven trine supports teamwork, so propose a joint venture that could amplify your earnings. Financially, the Moon’s square to your ascendant in the 4th House warns against reckless spending on home matters, urging disciplined budgeting. Avoid impulsive decisions in the 4th House, where the Moon squares your ascendant, to prevent domestic tension and preserve emotional balance. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
